lesson.title: Educate Antifragilly
lesson.topic: Exploring how education systems can be made antifragile to better prepare students for uncertainty and growth.
lesson.steelman: How might a school system's curriculum benefit from incorporating hormesis, challenging students with progressively harder problems?
lesson.example: A high school that rotates teaching methods and subjects unpredictably each year to simulate real-world variability and stress resilience.

rationale: Adding this lesson emphasizes the application of antifragility principles in a critical area like education, enhancing students' adaptability.
